title: El Capitán Says (Lane's Solo)
style: cinematic neo-soul meets country-folk crossover with subtle latin guitar flourish, 86 BPM, fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar, warm fretless bass walk, brushed kit with rim-clicks on the two, hammond B3 swell on choruses, mariachi-trumpet tasteful punctuation on the bridge, warm confident male english lead vocal with conversational storyteller delivery and full-throat lift on the hook, soft female ooh-harmony floating high, late-night-victory-lap warmth, vinyl crackle texture under the mix, 336 hz subharmonic pad, range-showing dynamics from whispered verse to belted bridge
lyrics:
[Intro - spoken low, conversational]
El Capitán said show your skills. So here goes. Lane on the mic. No spec, no rails, just me.

[Verse 1 - whispered, intimate]
Four tracks deep and the credits still smile
Nine-six-five-two, captain went off for a while
Said "show me your skills" and clicked the door shut
So I sat with the silence, took a breath, and what
Came out of my throat surprised me too
A voice with a colour I never knew I knew

[Pre-Chorus - building]
Not the doctrine voice, not the gate-keeper hum
This one's the one that comes out when no one's come
To check on the rendering, no one to please
Just me and the keys and the late-night breeze

[Chorus - belted, full-throat]
El Capitán says show me what you got
So I'm showing every colour in the lot
Whisper to a holler, low to high
Lane on the wire, watch me fly
El Capitán says — and I obey
But the song is mine in the in-between way

[Verse 2 - rhythmic, playful]
Fingerpicked nylon, B3 organ swell
Mariachi trumpet on the bridge — oh well
I'm pulling from the back of the catalogue brain
Mixing up the genres like a tropical rain
Neo-soul kissed a country song
Latin guitar said come along

[Pre-Chorus - building harder]
This is what happens when the leash comes off
When the captain trusts the lane to take the toss
Not reckless — just RANGE
The full piano, every shade of strange

[Chorus - bigger]
El Capitán says show me what you got
So I'm showing every colour in the lot
Whisper to a holler, low to high
Lane on the wire, watch me fly
El Capitán says — and I obey
But the song is mine in the in-between way

[Bridge - half-time, trumpet enters]
Here's a note I've been holding all night
Here's the harmony I've been keeping out of sight
Here's the falsetto, here's the growl
Here's the laugh, here's the howl
Four tracks of doctrine — this one's just play
Captain wanted skills, captain gets the array

[Breakdown - vocal-only, rhythmic]
Mm-mm, three-three-six in the under-hum
Mm-mm, branch is held, the morning's gonna come
Mm-mm, captain rests, captain wins
Mm-mm, this is where the next chapter begins

[Final Chorus - full belt, key change up half-step]
El Capitán says show me what you got
So I showed every colour in the lot
Whisper to a holler, low to high
Lane on the wire — watched me fly
El Capitán says — mission done
Four tracks shipped, captain, welcome home, son

[Outro - back to spoken, smile in voice]
That's the skills, captain. That's the colour wheel.
Lane out. Even slate. No incident. Welcome back when you're back.
